Extraction logic:
1. Skills section categories → each skill = EvidenceItem(claim=skill, level=LEVEL_1_DIRECT, source_section='Technical Skills', source_type=LISTED_SKILL, evidence_text=skill)
2. Experience bullets → for each bullet text, scan for _KNOWN_TECHNOLOGIES → each match = EvidenceItem(level=LEVEL_2_CONTEXTUAL, source_type=PROFESSIONAL_EXPERIENCE)
3. Project entries → each technology in project.technologies list = EvidenceItem(level=LEVEL_2_CONTEXTUAL, source_type=PROJECT_EXPERIENCE). Also scan bullets for tech.
4. Summary text → scan for _KNOWN_TECHNOLOGIES → LEVEL_1_DIRECT, source_type=SUMMARY
5. Years of experience: regex `r'(\d+\+?\s*years?)'` on summary text. Store first match verbatim.
6. Certifications → each cert name = LEVEL_1_DIRECT, category=CERTIFICATION
7. Metrics: scan all bullet text for patterns like `r'\d+[%$]|\d+x|\d+,\d+|\$\d+'` → LEVEL_1_DIRECT, category=METRIC

After collecting all items, populate supported_technologies and adjacent_technologies from items.

Matching logic:
- Normalize all claims and evidence to lowercase for comparison
- For each JD technology/skill: check evidence_set.supported_technologies (case-insensitive). Also check synonyms (postgres→postgresql, js→javascript, etc.)
